p4_obj_14.SP: The bison stays at the edge of the herd.
p4_obj_14.PC: The bison is wandering at the edge of the herd.
p4_obj_14.PA: The bison wandered away from the herd.
p4_obj_14.PX: The bison was wandering slowly when the riders came past.
p4_obj_14.PP: The bison has wandered a long way.
p4_obj_14.GO: The bison is going to walk back to the herd.
p4_obj_14.WI: The bison will join the others soon.

p4_obj_17.SP: The red sandstone cliff rises above the desert.
p4_obj_17.PC: The red sandstone cliff is glowing in the sun.
p4_obj_17.PA: The wind shaped the red sandstone cliff over thousands of years.
p4_obj_17.PX: The red sandstone cliff was glowing when the sun came up.
p4_obj_17.PP: The red sandstone cliff has stood here for a very long time.
p4_obj_17.GO: The red sandstone cliff is going to turn orange at sunset.
p4_obj_17.WI: The red sandstone cliff will cast a long shadow tonight.

p4_obj_19.SP: The white clouds change shape as they drift.
p4_obj_19.PC: The white clouds are floating across the blue sky.
p4_obj_19.PA: The white clouds floated across the sky.
p4_obj_19.PX: The white clouds were floating over the cliffs.
p4_obj_19.PP: The white clouds have drifted towards the mountains.
p4_obj_19.GO: The white clouds are going to cover the sun.
p4_obj_19.WI: The white clouds will bring a little shade.

p4_obj_37.SP: The yucca plant grows well in the dry desert.
p4_obj_37.PC: The yucca plant is growing in the dry sand.
p4_obj_37.PA: The yucca plant grew tall spiky leaves.
p4_obj_37.PX: The yucca plant was growing slowly in the heat.
p4_obj_37.PP: The yucca plant has survived many dry summers.
p4_obj_37.GO: The yucca plant is going to flower in the spring.
p4_obj_37.WI: The yucca plant will need very little water.

p4_obj_57.SP: The bald eagle hunts over the desert.
p4_obj_57.PC: The bald eagle is soaring over the desert.
p4_obj_57.PA: The bald eagle soared high over the cliffs.
p4_obj_57.PX: The bald eagle was soaring over the riders.
p4_obj_57.PP: The bald eagle has spotted something below.
p4_obj_57.GO: The bald eagle is going to dive down.
p4_obj_57.WI: The bald eagle will fly back to its nest.

p4_obj_63.SP: The vulture perches on the windmill.
p4_obj_63.PC: The vulture is perching on the windmill tower.
p4_obj_63.PA: The vulture landed on the windmill tower.
p4_obj_63.PX: The vulture was perching on the tower when the blades started turning.
p4_obj_63.PP: The vulture has watched the ranch all morning.
p4_obj_63.GO: The vulture is going to fly over the desert.
p4_obj_63.WI: The vulture will look for food later.

labels: Bird with its nest and chicks on the roof
p4_obj_83.PC: The bird is feeding its chicks on the roof.
p4_obj_83.GO: The bird is going to fly off to find more insects.

p4_obj_106.PC: The sheep is grazing in the green pen.

p4_obj_112.SP: The ranch sign shows the name of the ranch.
p4_obj_112.PC: The ranch sign is hanging over the gate.
p4_obj_112.PA: The rancher hung the sign over the gate.
p4_obj_112.PX: The ranch sign was swinging in the wind.
p4_obj_112.PP: The sign has welcomed visitors for many years.
p4_obj_112.GO: The rancher is going to paint the sign again.
p4_obj_112.WI: Visitors will see the sign from the road.

p4_obj_126.SP: The beagle follows the pony everywhere.
p4_obj_126.PC: The beagle is running beside the pony.
p4_obj_126.PA: The beagle ran beside the girl on the pony.
p4_obj_126.PX: The beagle was running beside the pony when it started to bark.
p4_obj_126.PP: The beagle has run around the yard three times.
p4_obj_126.GO: The beagle is going to lie down in the shade.
p4_obj_126.WI: The beagle will sleep well tonight.

p4_obj_134.SP: The suitcases travel on top of the jeep.
p4_obj_134.PC: The suitcases are sitting on the roof rack.
p4_obj_134.PA: The man tied the suitcases onto the roof rack.
p4_obj_134.PX: The suitcases were bouncing on the roof rack on the bumpy road.
p4_obj_134.PP: The suitcases have stayed on the roof rack all day.
p4_obj_134.GO: The man is going to lift the suitcases down.
p4_obj_134.WI: The suitcases will be dusty after the trip.

p4_obj_143.PC: The window is letting daylight into the barn.

p4_obj_145.SP: The rocks lie along the fence.
p4_obj_145.PC: The rocks are lying by the fence.
p4_obj_145.PA: Someone piled the rocks by the fence.
p4_obj_145.PX: The rocks were lying in the sun.
p4_obj_145.PP: The rocks have been there for years.
p4_obj_145.GO: The lizard is going to sit on the warm rocks.
p4_obj_145.WI: The rocks will stay hot until the evening.

labels: White spotted pony rolling on the ground
p4_obj_155.SP: The pony likes to roll in the dirt after its dinner.
p4_obj_155.PA: The pony lay down and rolled happily in the dust.
p4_obj_155.PX: The pony was rolling in the dust when the rooster crowed.
p4_obj_155.PP: The pony has rolled over three times.
p4_obj_155.GO: The pony is going to stand up and shake off the dust.
p4_obj_155.WI: The pony will need a good brush later.

p4_obj_160.SP: The palomino horse waits patiently in the corral.
p4_obj_160.PC: The palomino horse is waiting in the corral.
p4_obj_160.PA: The palomino horse waited by the fence.
p4_obj_160.PX: The palomino horse was waiting when the girl brought the hay.
p4_obj_160.PP: The palomino horse has waited all morning for its food.
p4_obj_160.GO: The palomino horse is going to eat some hay.
p4_obj_160.WI: The palomino horse will pull the cart tomorrow.

p4_obj_169.SP: The piglet runs around the pen.
p4_obj_169.PC: The piglet is running around the pen.
p4_obj_169.PA: The piglet ran around the pen.
p4_obj_169.PX: The piglet was running around when the farmer opened the gate.
p4_obj_169.PP: The piglet has run around the pen all morning.
p4_obj_169.GO: The piglet is going to sleep in the mud.
p4_obj_169.WI: The piglet will grow big and strong.

p4_obj_182.PC: The baby donkey is kicking up its legs.
p4_obj_182.SP: The baby donkey likes to kick up its legs.
p4_obj_182.PA: The baby donkey kicked up its legs.
p4_obj_182.PX: The baby donkey was kicking up its legs in the sun.
p4_obj_182.PP: The baby donkey has played all morning.
p4_obj_182.GO: The baby donkey is going to rest beside its mother.
p4_obj_182.WI: The baby donkey will grow big like its mother.

p4_obj_189.SP: The red and white cow eats hay in the yard.
p4_obj_189.PC: The red and white cow is eating hay.
p4_obj_189.PA: The red and white cow ate some hay.
p4_obj_189.PX: The red and white cow was eating hay when the bull jumped.
p4_obj_189.PP: The cow has eaten most of the hay.
p4_obj_189.GO: The cow is going to drink from the trough.
p4_obj_189.WI: The farmer will milk the cow this evening.

p4_obj_205.PC: The farm boy is raking straw in the barn.

p4_obj_6.PC: The desert tree is growing on the open plain.
